originality.rationale: The exact iid Bernoulli/Rademacher digit-series law, all-N standardized fourth moment, Exp(1) logarithmic-error scale and matched-variance Gaussian comparator are not implied by the variance/gain-coefficient results of Suzuki or Yue–Hickernell, nor by Liu’s empirical heavy-tail observations. The closest indexed records concern mathematically different quadrature randomizations. Unindexed historical coverage remains a residual priority risk.
residual_risks: An unindexed older calculation may derive the same finite-digit Bernoulli representation under a different name.
Prior general Walsh-transform identities may imply the stated fourth moment after nontrivial specialization, although no direct matching theorem was found.
The contextual Liu preprint later has a withdrawn version; it is not used as a correctness premise.

value.rationale: The smooth coordinate benchmark on a full dyadic net is an established QMC diagnostic. Its exact rare-event and typical-error versus RMS behavior, contrasted with a variance-identical nested scheme, resolves a mathematically motivated distinction invisible to the existing gain-coefficient and variance results.
